notes.title: Small Update (EA: Version 0.1.6):
notes.content:

notes.title: Update EA 0.1.5: Minimap, Shotgun, Custom Cursor & Major Optimizations!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a new update that brings exciting new features and important improvements to both Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes. Here’s what’s new:

🧭 Minimap in Singleplayer
The Singleplayer mode now features a minimap located in the top-left corner of the screen!
Currently, it shows the player's position and the marked buildings.
You can also hold down the "M" key to open a larger, detailed map for better navigation.

🔫 New Weapon: Shotgun
We’ve added a shotgun as a new weapon!
It’s much more powerful and effective at close range compared to the pistol.
At the moment, the pistol and shotgun share the same total ammo, but this will change in future updates as we expand the weapon inventory system with separate ammo types and more weapons.

🖱️ Custom Cursor
We’ve introduced a custom game cursor to better fit the overall style and gameplay experience.

🌐 Multiplayer Improvements
In Multiplayer, we’ve:

Fixed several notable bugs

Optimized the host-client-server data flow,
preventing overloads and ensuring a smoother experience for hosts

🎮 Overall Performance
We’ve also implemented general performance improvements across the game.
FPS drops should no longer occur and gameplay should feel smoother overall.

🌲 What’s Next?
We’ve started work on:

Expanding the forest area

Developing a mysterious surprise game that will appear in a special "surprise scene"

Stay tuned – lots of exciting content is on the way!

Thanks for playing and supporting us – have fun with the new update!

— The Demon Alive Team

notes.title: 🎮 Big Update: The NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE is here! 🎮
notes.content:
Dear community,
We’re thrilled to finally unveil our brand-new Multiplayer Mode, featuring two completely different gameplay scenarios that throw you into the heart of dark and thrilling action!

We also want to sincerely apologize for the slight delay. As a thank-you, we’ve included a few small surprises in this update—keep your eyes open! 👀

💡 Important Note: Both multiplayer modes can also be fully enjoyed solo—everything is playable in singleplayer as well!

🕯 Shadow Hunt – Curse of the Chalice
Enter a chilling co-op horror adventure for 1–4 players.
Search for keys to unlock the cursed chalice while surviving a new demon with unique, deadly abilities each round. Use your flashlight to pierce the darkness—but beware, light attracts certain creatures.
Hide, stay quiet, and work together to escape. Will you lift the curse or join the victims?

Features:

Unique demons with evolving abilities

Playable solo or with up to 4 players

Dark, immersive environments

Stealth mechanics and smart resource management

🔥 Demon Flood – Aksa's Last Stand
Fight through endless demon waves in this fast-paced co-op shooter for 1–4 players.
Defend the city of Aksa using a powerful arsenal—from pistols to shotguns—and survive increasingly brutal hordes. Brace yourself for the final showdown with the Hell Lord. Coordination is key. Will Aksa stand—or fall?

Features:

Solo or co-op gameplay (1–4 players)

Wide range of weapons

Intensifying demon waves + epic boss battle

Tactical team-based mechanics—even when solo

⚙ Performance Improvements & Bug Fixes
We’ve made big under-the-hood improvements:

Major performance optimizations

Countless small (and invisible) bugs fixed

A smoother and more stable experience across the board

🐞 Your Feedback Matters!
As the new multiplayer mode is fresh out of development, we’d love your help!
Please report bugs and share your ideas with us—on Steam or our Website. Your feedback helps us improve the game even more.

Thanks for your continued support—see you in the darkness!
– Your Demon Alive Team

notes.title: 🔥 (EA) Version 0.1.3 Update Released! 🔥
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard to bring you a more immersive and optimized experience. Here’s what’s new:

🩸 New Blood System – More realistic and dynamic blood effects for intense battles.

🎯 Improved Shooting Mechanics – A new crosshair-based aiming system in FPS mode. The flashlight on the pistol now precisely marks the center of your aim.

👹 New Enemy Type – Now featuring a visible health bar above their heads, so you’ll know exactly when these demons are about to fall.

⚠️ Enhanced Player Damage System – A directional damage indicator helps you identify incoming threats more effectively.

🚀 Massive Optimization Work – We’ve made significant improvements to ensure smoother gameplay.

NOTE (Multiplayer Update): 
Our multiplayer system is in a great state, and the testing phase will begin in the next few days. This means the full release is coming in Q1! Stay tuned!

🔫 Prepare for battle and jump into the chaos against the demons now! 🔥

notes.title: Demon Alive 2025: Q1 & Q2 Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311698/91964251e4117273717b665aef6d4e22a2aca7e1.jpg[/img]

We’re thrilled to share a glimpse of the exciting content coming to Demon Alive 2025 in the first half of the year:

Q1: Multiplayer Mode
The highly anticipated multiplayer mode is here! Team up with friends to face the dark hordes together or challenge each other in intense battles. Two brand-new, immersive maps are ready to deliver the ultimate multiplayer experience. Prepare for thrilling combat, strategic challenges, and cooperative action like never before.

Q2: Expanding the Forest
The mystical forest is growing—and becoming even more dangerous! Explore new areas filled with secrets, challenges, and deadly creatures waiting to test your skills. But that’s not all: we’re introducing exciting new features to make your gameplay even more dynamic. Stay tuned for more details!

Get ready for an epic year in the world of Demon Alive 2025!

notes.title: 🌟 Latest Update: New Achievements, Enhanced Interactions, and Bug Fixes🌟
notes.content:
[b]Early Access Version 0.1.2:
[/b]- Fixed Collider Issues: Resolved collider problems in Houses 2 and 3 to ensure smoother navigation and interactions.
- Added Reset Button: Introduced a reset button to the input field for the puzzle in House 5, allowing players to easily reset their entries.
- New Achievements: Added two new achievements to enhance player rewards and engagement.
- Improved Street Lighting: Updated street lamps to emit light, creating a more realistic and immersive atmosphere.
- Audio Player Slider Integration: Implemented an audio player slider for in-game sounds within the pause menu, providing better audio control and experience.
- Enhanced Object Interactions: Increased the number of interactive objects in almost all houses, offering more engaging gameplay opportunities.
- Minor Bug Fixes and Optimizations: Addressed various small bugs and optimized game performance for a smoother experience.
- Feedback and Support: For any further bugs or suggestions, please reach out to us.
